verses.text: The LORD said to my Lord, “Sit at my right side, until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.”

footnotes.text: right side: See the note at 16.11.

verses.text: The LORD will let your power reach out from Zion, and you will rule over your enemies.
Your glorious power will be seen on the day you begin to rule. You will wear the sacred robes and shine like the morning sun in all of your strength.

footnotes.text: You will … strength: One possible meaning for the difficult Hebrew text.

verses.text: The LORD has made a promise that will never be broken: “You will be a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
The Lord is at your right side, and when he gets angry he will crush the other kings.
He will judge the nations and crack their skulls, leaving piles of dead bodies all over the earth.
He will drink from any stream that he chooses, while winning victory after victory.

footnotes.text: while … victory: Or “God will give him victory after victory.”
